lines.text: The Pokémon Tower was erected in the memory\nof Pokémon that passed away.
Did you come to pay respects?\nBless your Pokémon-loving heart, son.
Did you come to pay respects?\nBless your Pokémon-loving heart, girl.
I can’t forget my dearly departed Clefairy.\c\n*sob*\nOh, this won’t do. I’m awash in tears...
My sweet Growlithe...\nWhy did you have to die and leave me?
I am a channeler—one who speaks to spirits.\nI sense a lost spirit somewhere high in this tower.
The presence of the lost spirit I sensed farther\nup the tower has...disappeared!
